name: decision audit
summary: Run the commanders-advocate over the pilot's decisions and check for commander records that have not been applied to those decision files.
statement: Run the commander advocate over the pilot decisions. Check for commander records that have not been applied to these decision files.
brief: Given in chat on 2026-09-25 after the pilot reported the state of the corpus migration, with XD-007 to XD-011 awaiting approval. Beside it the commander left a note (CN, kept inline in chat, not extracted) that at least one record is not yet integrated: one requiring the pilot to state actions or conduct with the reasoning inside the decision files.
